_comment: Which of mxm-chorus-06's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
`fx.chorus` IS DELIBERATELY UNFILLED. It is a stepped role - the built-in chorus's Off / I /
II / Both switch - and this plugin has no switch: Mix at zero is Off, and an existing role's
curve is never changed (docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md section 5). The three roles below were
appended to the Effects page in the same change as this plugin, which is the rule under
which a plugin may claim a role (section 9's mxm-mono-02 case).
Noise is off the controller: a setup control, not a performance one.
